results.title: Inventory
evidence: 340 nodes (310 executable + 30 sticky notes), 289 connection sources, active=false

results.title: Every Execute Workflow node targets a workflow that exists and has an Execute Workflow Trigger
evidence: 10 Execute Workflow nodes, 1 Execute Workflow Trigger node(s)
10 target "$workflow.id" (this same workflow, valid under any import id)

results.title: Unreachable nodes (no trigger can ever reach them)
Triggers that lead nowhere (a registered webhook/schedule that does nothing)
results.fix: Remove after confirming nothing calls it (W4 – Webhook /cal-w4-test).

results.title: Duplicate webhook method+path
Export is ACTIVE: importing it into a fresh n8n starts listening/sending before configuration is tested
results.fix: Export with active=false; activate only after configuration, templates and tests.

results.title: Expressions/code that reference a node name that does not exist
Accidental circular execution (cycle not guarded by a batch loop)
Workflow settings: time zone, error handling and execution-data retention are not set in the file
evidence: every schedule (W3 10 min, W5 15 min, W6 10:00, W7/W8 hourly, W9 Mon 09:00, W10 1 min, W13 08:05) runs in the INSTANCE time zone unless the workflow sets one
successful executions (which contain patient phone numbers and message text) are kept per the instance default

results.title: Webhooks that answer 200 BEFORE any validation or storage ("onReceived")
results.fix: Use "Respond to Webhook" after the real outcome is known.

results.title: Public webhooks with no n8n authentication (must authenticate in the workflow itself)
Staff alert is a STUB: the message is built, nothing is delivered, and the run is logged as done
evidence: node "W1 – Staff alert (stub)" is a Code node with no send; it feeds "W1 – Write Run_Log"

results.title: Website enquiry is acknowledged (200) before it is validated or stored
evidence: W1 – Webhook responseMode=onReceived; "W1 – Create lead" runs AFTER the response, so the website is told success even if storage fails

results.title: No email gateway anywhere (no Send Email / SMTP node)
evidence: no email node in the workflow

results.title: W1 does not capture consent (source, timestamp, status) for WhatsApp/email contact
evidence: "W1 – Prepare lead" has no consent field; the CRM only has Leads.Opted_Out

results.title: Inbound WhatsApp POST is not authenticated: no X-Hub-Signature-256 check, so any caller can inject "patient" messages
Meta verify token is a literal inside the workflow (Set node), so it is in every export, backup and screenshot
Delivery receipts (statuses[]) are counted but never stored: "accepted by Meta" is never upgraded to delivered/read/failed
evidence: "W2 – Parse Meta Event" returns statuses_seen only; no W2 node writes a delivered/read/failed status

results.title: Webhook handshake (GET) and message de-duplication are present
evidence: clinic is resolved from metadata.phone_number_id through the Agency Registry, never from a sender-supplied slug

results.title: Production messages use Meta's sample template 'hello_world' (patients would receive "Hello World")
results.fix: Use approved templates chosen by configuration; send nothing when none is configured.

results.title: A test phone number is stored as a literal in W3 – Config
Sticky notes still say "the send is a STUB" although the sections already call W12 (misleading to the operator)
Sent-flag is written AFTER the send, with no claim before it: two overlapping runs or a retry can send the same message twice
evidence: W3: Build Message -> Call W12 -> Sent? -> flag (W7, W8 and W10 claim first)
W5: Build Message -> Call W12 -> Sent? -> flag (W7, W8 and W10 claim first)
W6: Build Message -> Call W12 -> Sent? -> flag (W7, W8 and W10 claim first)
results.fix: Central idempotency in W12 (claim a row keyed by the message before calling Meta).

results.title: Obsolete unauthenticated test webhook /cal-w4-test is registered and connected to nothing
Cal.com HMAC is computed over JSON.stringify(parsed body), not the exact raw bytes
evidence: "W4 – Verify & parse" signs a re-serialisation; "W4 – Webhook1" has no Raw Body option
results.fix: Enable Raw Body and verify the received bytes.

results.title: Cal.com webhook is answered 200 before the signature is checked ("onReceived"), so a forged or failed booking looks accepted
evidence: "W4 – Webhook1" responseMode=onReceived; a bad signature only ends in a stop-and-error node after the 200

results.title: Booking confirmation is a STUB: no WhatsApp confirmation is ever sent
evidence: "W4 – Plan writes" builds the confirmation with stub: true; W4 has no Call W12 node

results.title: No replay window (event time is not checked) and no explicit time-zone handling in W4
evidence: "W4 – Verify & parse" does not look at the event time

results.title: W5 reminder: schedule every 15 min; sent flag set after send (see D04)
mark_lost is disabled (leads are never marked lost automatically)
W7 claims Outcome_Sent before sending; honours Needs_Human / opt-out
Review requests are not filtered by mood and need an https review_link (no deceptive review gating)
evidence: W8 – Plan: "Deliberately NO filter on mood, outcome"; review link must be https

results.title: W10 claims the staff reply row before sending and stops on opt-out / invalid phone / closed 24 h window
W9 sends the weekly metrics to an external AI provider (OpenRouter)
W11 alert hides tokens/digits but the Telegram chat id is a literal in the Config node
W11 covers the whole workflow because it is one workflow with an Error Trigger (n8n runs a workflow that contains an Error Trigger as its own error workflow)
A timeout / unclear Meta answer counts as SENT (w12_uncertain_counts_as_sent=true): the lead is marked contacted and staff are told it was sent
Graph API version is a literal in the node (verify it is still supported before go-live)
No central idempotency in W12: nothing stops the same message being sent twice by a retry or a parallel run
evidence: no W12 node checks for an earlier send of the same message

results.title: Meta send: timeout 15 s, no automatic retry, errors do not throw (neverError), classified accepted / rejected / uncertain
Uncertain sends cannot be reconciled: no callback data is sent with the message, and statuses are ignored (C03)
evidence: no biz_opaque_callback_data in the send request

results.title: TLS certificate verification is switched OFF for the model request (allowUnauthorizedCerts=true): a man-in-the-middle could read patient text and API key
Patient name, earlier AI summary, first enquiry, appointments and the last conversation messages are sent to an external AI provider without redaction
evidence: aiFacts() puts "PATIENT - name", "earlier summary", "first enquiry" and RECENT CONVERSATION into the prompt
W13 – Provider Request sends it to openrouter.ai unchanged

results.title: AI reply rate limit is effectively off
No global switch that keeps external AI off until the clinic has approved provider, terms, retention and data fields
evidence: ai_mode is per clinic (default off: good), but nothing stops a mis-set clinic row from sending patient text abroad

results.title: ai_mode defaults to off; replies are fact-checked against the Knowledge table; emergencies and complaints go to a person
evidence: Settings.ai_mode off/draft/auto; W13 – Plan validates schema, prices, times, links and phone numbers

results.title: AI provider and model are literals
Grist base URL is a literal in 0 Config nodes (internal Docker name: only valid where that hostname resolves)
Agency Registry document id is a literal in 0 Config nodes
Secrets stored as literals in Set nodes
97 nodes reference credentials by id: ids do not transfer between n8n installations (re-bind them after import)
Number of nodes that read configuration from environment variables
Phone numbers are forced into +91 (Indian mobile only): international numbers are rejected or mangled
Missed-call capture is NOT implemented in this workflow (no telephony webhook, no provider)
evidence: no webhook path contains "call"; the website/WhatsApp flow must not be presented as missed-call capture
